title: Run the API spike notebook
body: Run notebooks/00_api_exploration.ipynb end to end with a real API key. Acceptance: all sections run; findings JSON saved.

title: Fill in data notes from spike
body: Complete docs/05-data-notes.md: endpoint no-data behaviour, Q1–Q10 status, measurements, quirks. Update assumptions A4, A5.

title: Time 3 manual company checks
body: Do 3 due-diligence checks by hand on the Companies House website and time them. Replace the 20–40 min assumption (A2) with real numbers.

title: Run 3 user interviews
body: Use the script in docs/02-users-and-questions.md §4. Record findings in docs/user-research.md; update personas and Q1–Q10 ranking.

title: Record project process
body: Record the project process in development/*. Explain all the phases, journals, and why we use the tools we do.

title: Stakeholder sign-off on project brief
body: Send docs/kickoff/project-brief.md to AAII. Record decision in the sign-off table and decision log.
